title: Who wires our shows? Just ask. #selfhosted
description:
Ask for the person, get a contact chip, tap it — the exact Contacts card opens. Or search a word from your notes when the name escapes you. This is Micelclaw Contacts, running on your own hardware.

Full tour: https://youtu.be/T-YhWeZwYuI
